index.title: Learn ZudoJS — from JavaScript to your first backend
index.description: A free, hands-on course: learn JavaScript for the backend, move to TypeScript, then build a Task API with the ZudoJS framework. Every example runs in your browser and on your computer.
index.heading: Learn ZudoJS
index.lead: Start with plain JavaScript, move to TypeScript, then build a real backend with ZudoJS. Every example runs in the terminal on this page, and every lesson shows you how to run it on your own computer and what you should see.

parts.title: JavaScript for the backend
parts.summary: Install Node.js and learn the JavaScript a backend developer uses every day: values, functions, objects, JSON, async code and modules.
